00061 class RGBAColour
00062 {
00063 public:
00064     RGBAColour(float red = 0.f, float green = 0.f, float blue = 0.f, float alpha = 1.f) throw() 
00065     :   r(red), g(green), b(blue), a(alpha) { }
00066     
00067     RGBAColour(double red, double green, double blue, double alpha = 1.0) throw() 
00068     :   r((float)red), g((float)green), b((float)blue), a((float)alpha) { }
00069     
00070     RGBAColour(int red, int green, int blue, int alpha = 255) throw() 
00071     :   r(red / 255.f), g(green / 255.f), b(blue / 255.f), a(alpha / 255.f) { }
00072     
00073     RGBAColour(unsigned int rgba) throw()
00074     {
00075         a = (rgba & 0xFF) / 255.f;  rgba = rgba >> 8;
00076         b = (rgba & 0xFF) / 255.f;  rgba = rgba >> 8;
00077         g = (rgba & 0xFF) / 255.f;  rgba = rgba >> 8;
00078         r = (rgba & 0xFF) / 255.f;
00079     }
00080     
00081     inline float red() throw()      { return r; }
00082     inline float green() throw()    { return g; }
00083     inline float blue() throw()     { return b; }
00084     inline float alpha() throw()    { return a; }
00085     
00086     inline unsigned long redInt() throw()       { unsigned long ret = (unsigned long)(r*255.f); return ret; }
00087     inline unsigned long greenInt() throw()     { unsigned long ret = (unsigned long)(g*255.f); return ret; }
00088     inline unsigned long blueInt() throw()      { unsigned long ret = (unsigned long)(b*255.f); return ret; }
00089     inline unsigned long alphaInt() throw()     { unsigned long ret = (unsigned long)(a*255.f); return ret; }
00090     
00091     inline unsigned long get32bitColour() throw() 
00092     { 
00093         unsigned long ret = ((alphaInt() << 24) | (redInt() << 16) | (greenInt() << 8) | blueInt()); 
00094         return ret;
00095     }
00096     
00097     inline float* getFloatArray() throw() { return &r; }
00098     
00099     static const RGBAColour& getNull() throw()
00100     {
00101         static RGBAColour null;
00102         return null;
00103     }
00104     
00105 private:
00106     float r,g,b,a;
00107 };
